answer: Each identity must tender a fresh, unrepeatable artefact of reviewed labour that later peers can re-execute. A newcomer submits one audited task, and its slot stays open only while that work records real, dated output. A farm repeating the same artefact is voided at audit, and a disproved entry forfeits the whole slot bond. Since each artefact is bound to one key and cannot be reused, running many names multiplies audits and bonds without multiplying influence. cedar yarrow bridge
